response.original_title: KiLL YOur WiNTerxxx -THANK YOU I LOVE SUMMER-
response.overview: On 6 December 2020 BiS brought their autumn tour KiLL YOur WiNTerxxx to a close at the Fukuoka Sun Palace, a 2,300-seat civic hall on the Hakata waterfront. The run had opened in Nagoya on 18 October and passed through Sapporo, Kyoto and Sendai, each date carrying its own joke subtitle; the last one was -THANK YOU I LOVE SUMMER-. BiS played twice that Sunday, and what is captured here is the 19:00 evening show, the only one of the two carried on that night's pay-per-view stream. The four members of the group's third generation — Toggy, Ito Musensiteebu, Chantmonkee and Neo Trees — open with "STUPiD" and work through seventeen songs to "TOUCH ME" before returning for an encore that gives over its first eleven minutes to talk and then closes on "BiS -Douyara Zombie no Odemashi-" and "CURTAiN CALL". Ending the tour in Fukuoka meant ending it in Chantmonkee's home prefecture.
response.title: BiS: KiLL YOur WiNTerxxx -THANK YOU I LOVE SUMMER-
